items.title: Last Straws: John Chaffe, Bris Jones, Bill Lee, Frank De La Houssaye, Bob Ice Interview, 1960-04-18
items.q: The interviewee does not speak in the provided context; the interviewer mentions Scott Dunbar as a guitar player they were looking for, but there is no evidence of a personal connection or interaction with the interviewee.

ctx.x: You lived in a lot of places. Oh, well, I was born in Memphis, but my home has always been Woodville, Mississippi. I mean, that was my hometown until I went to a couple other schools.

I've been through there. I was selling fish there, I noticed, last weekend. I was at, right on the square. I was looking for a guitar player from there, Scott Dunbar. Oh? Yeah, he's a real good guitar player. He's made some records. When were you there? A couple of weeks ago, I was on my way to Natchez.
Well, I was in Natchez two weeks ago. In fact, I went to Woodville the same weekend, I bet you. Were you there on a Sunday?
